newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian shares close mixed in doubled volume.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian shares close mixed in doubled volume.

text.p: Palestinian shares closed mixed on Tuesday with trading volume almost double last week's level, a Palestine Securities Exchange (PSE) report showed.
The report said 66,401 shares worth 96,864 Jordanian dinars were traded during the 18th weekly session since the exchange opened for business in February.
Last week, 37,116 shares worth 59,457 dinars were traded.
Trading in Palestine Telecommunications Co accounted for about two thirds of Tuesday's turnover, with 63,560 shares worth 45,400 dinars changing hands.
Palestine Investment and Development Co posted the sharpest drop, closing 4.76 percent down at one dinar from 1.05 dinars last week.
National Insurance Co made the biggest gain. Its shares closed at 2.04 Jordanian dinars from 2.00 last week, up 2.0 percent.

The stock exchange opened in February with one weekly trading session. It plans to move to two weekly trading sessions starting in July. The exchange is yet to issue an index, which officials say will be published only after the number of companies traded reaches 15.
